belief: Money and things will make me happy.
origins: We are surrounded by messages that the right income and possessions deliver contentment. Seeing the relief money brings in a crisis reinforces it. The pursuit can take over life and relationships, and each level reached shows another one to chase.
teaches: Solomon writes, “He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.” Jesus said, “Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth… For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.” He asks, “What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?” Paul tells the rich “not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.” God is not against enjoying good things. He warns that they cannot carry the weight of our hearts.
self_statements: I will be happy when I earn more.
The next raise will do it.
I need more to feel secure.
If I could just afford that, I would be content.
errors: Believing that more money guarantees happiness.
Feeling wanting and concluding it must be filled by money.
questions: What have I hoped money would give me?
When have I had more and been no happier?
What gives me lasting joy that is not for sale?
Where is my treasure, and where is my heart?
What does Scripture say about the limits of wealth?
What is one way to enjoy what I have and share it?
truth: Money is a useful tool and a poor master. It cannot give lasting happiness. My hope is in God, who richly provides things to enjoy. I can use money wisely, enjoy it, and share it.
hw_truths: My treasure should be in heaven.
Hope belongs in God, not wealth.
I can be content with enough.
log: Each week, note one source of joy that did not cost money.
actions: Write what you hope more money will give.
Write ten sources of joy that do not cost money.
Share money or time with someone in need.
Define a level of income or spending that is enough.
prayer: Lord, I have looked to money for happiness. Teach me to use it wisely, to enjoy Your gifts, and to find my joy in You. Amen.
hw_questions: What do I hope money gives?
name_example: Sarah can write: “My treasure is in heaven, so money will not decide my happiness.”
meta: Christian belief counseling for “Money and things will make me happy.” with BSB scriptures, questions, songs, and practical homework.
